theme_and_art_direction.vibe: Award-worthy, editorial, kinetic, trustworthy, high-contrast, deep depth
theme_and_art_direction.description: A high-conversion cybersecurity and digital signing landing page. Emphasizes dark mode with deep emerald/teal accents. It moves away from standard 'lock' imagery to a more transparent, data-dense, and structured aesthetic using glassmorphism and bento grids.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, and chapter numbers. Tight tracking (tracking-tight to tracking-tighter) for massive scale.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, descriptions, and feature text. Clean, geometric legibility.

mono.usage: Use for status tables, license keys, certificates, UI mockup data, and overlines.

layouts.general: Generous spacing. Use Tailwind's py-24 to py-32 for section padding. Containers should use max-w-7xl.
layouts.bento_grids: Use for Features and Security sections. Mix spans (col-span-1, col-span-2) with gap-6. Children must stretch full height.
layouts.editorial_markers: Include large, transparent stroke numbers (01, 02, etc.) positioned absolutely in the background of each section to act as 'chapters'.
layouts.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl or 2xl with bg-white/5 and an inner 1px border of border-white/10 for cards, floating navs, and product mockups.

motion.hero: Kinetic line-by-line masked reveal. Use framer-motion to reveal H1 text from bottom up with overflow-hidden wrappers.
motion.scroll_reveals: Staggered fade-up for features and bento boxes. Elements should translate-y-10 and opacity-0 to opacity-100 on scroll.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an editorial ribbon (e.g., 'ENTERPRISE SECURITY • PAdES COMPLIANT • LOCAL PROCESSING'). Keep it slow, elegant, and low contrast (opacity-30).
motion.ui_interactions: Micro-interactions on hover (scale 1.02, border glow). Sliders in the Signature Placement section must update the preview box in real-time.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise/grain overlay (fixed pointer-events-none div) across the entire application to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glows: Use soft radial gradients (bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_center,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))]) placed absolutely behind key sections (like hero and pricing) to create an emerald light bleed.
visual_enhancers.mockups: Instead of stock screenshots, build 'code-based mockups' using divs, borders, and JetBrains Mono to simulate the application interface directly in the DOM.

1_Hero.description: Kinetic hero section with abstract dark green background. Masked text reveal. Includes a UI mockup showing selected PDFs and a glassmorphic certificate card floating over it (RAHUL MEHTA, Class 3, eMudhra Sub CA).

2_Features.description: Bento grid outlining 6 core benefits: Single PDF Signing, Folder-Based Bulk Signing, Local Processing, Visible Signature Placement, Certificate Visibility, Clear Signing Status.

3_Product_Interface.description: Visual presentation of the tool's flow: Select docs -> Configure signature -> Sign & Export.

4_How_It_Works.description: 4 numbered steps in a vertical timeline or horizontal staggered cards: Select PDFs, Download/Config DSC, Sign in Bulk, Verify & Export.

5_Signature_Placement.description: INTERACTIVE PREVIEW. User controls horizontal/vertical position sliders and width/height inputs to move a 'Signature Box' inside a 'Document Canvas'.

6_Signing_Process.description: Status table simulating real-time signing. Columns: File Name, Token Name, Certificate Issuer, Status, Action. Animated badges for statuses (Signed, Signing, Ready, Token Required, Failed).

7_Security.description: Dark bento grid focusing on Local PDF Processing, USB DSC Signing, Certificate Review, Controlled Export. Use icons and metric numbers.

8_Pricing.description: Interactive licence cost estimator. Range slider for quantity. Tiers: Basic (1 licence, ₹2,200), Pro (5-10, ₹1,800), Business (11-50, ₹1,500), Enterprise (51+, ₹1,000). Calculates annual subtotal.

9_Contact_FAQ.description: Demo request form with glassmorphic styling (Full name, company, email, phone, plan, requirement). Accordion for 7 FAQ questions.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract dark green wavy lines to be used as a hero background or section separator overlay.

usb_token.description: Black USB flash drive plugged into a laptop. Perfect for the 'Download or Configure DSC' step.

secure_laptop.description: MacBook Pro edge. Good for general product or security ambiance.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the deep background passes APCA/WCAG standards. The emerald accents must be readable when used for text.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion reveals.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST use HTML and Tailwind for layout structuring instead of relying solely on Shadcn's Card/Section, to allow for overlapping and asymmetry.
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.
Never center-align large blocks of text; left-align to maintain readability and editorial feel.
Do not use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, sliders, form fields, table rows).
Use framer-motion extensively for scroll triggers and layout animations.
Use raw HTML DOM nodes with styling to build the 'UI Mockups' instead of relying entirely on images. This looks far more premium.
Install and configure 'lenis' for smooth scrolling.
Include glassmorphism and subtle grain textures as specified.
